findings.description: Dependabot bumped only @docusaurus/preset-classic to 3.10.2, leaving @docusaurus/core at 3.10.1. Docusaurus enforces exact version parity across all @docusaurus/* packages. The build failed with 'Invalid name=docusaurus-plugin-content-docs version number=3.10.2' because preset-classic's sub-plugins resolved to 3.10.2 while core was 3.10.1.

decision: Bumped @docusaurus/core and @docusaurus/module-type-aliases from 3.10.1 to 3.10.2 to match @docusaurus/preset-classic and @docusaurus/types. Committed to dependabot/npm_and_yarn/docusaurus/preset-classic-3.10.2 branch.
blockers: Dependabot force-pushed rebase during fix application, requiring re-application of the fix

findings.description: Dependabot PR #290 bumped @docusaurus/core to 3.10.2 but left @docusaurus/preset-classic and @docusaurus/module-type-aliases at 3.10.1. Docusaurus requires exact version parity. Build failed with 'Invalid name=docusaurus-plugin-content-docs version number=3.10.1'. Same root cause as PRs #288 and #289 — Dependabot does not coordinate @docusaurus/* version bumps.

decision: Bumped @docusaurus/preset-classic and @docusaurus/module-type-aliases to 3.10.2 to achieve full version parity across all four @docusaurus/* packages. Committed to dependabot/npm_and_yarn/docusaurus/core-3.10.2 branch.

findings.description: Dependabot PR #291 bumped @docusaurus/module-type-aliases to 3.10.2 but left @docusaurus/core, @docusaurus/preset-classic, and @docusaurus/types at 3.10.1. Docusaurus version parity violation. Same root cause as PRs #288, #289, #290 — Dependabot treats each @docusaurus/* package independently.

decision: Bumped @docusaurus/core, @docusaurus/preset-classic, and @docusaurus/types to 3.10.2 to achieve full version parity. Committed to dependabot/npm_and_yarn/docusaurus/module-type-aliases-3.10.2 branch.
